Name: WhatDoYouWant
Author: MniShark
Description:
[center][size=6][b]WhatDoYouWant 你想要什么[/b][/size][/center]
[center][i]在游戏内按一个快捷键，一目了然地看到你还差什么。[/i][/center]
[center][i]Press a hotkey in-game to see at a glance what you're still missing.[/i][/center]

[line]

[center][b]社区中心 · Joja社区发展 · 金核桃 · 出货 · 菜谱 · 鱼 · 博物馆 · 星之果实 · 多样化种植 · 商店轮换商品[/b][/center]
[center][b]Community Center · Joja Community Development · Golden Walnuts · Shipping · Recipes · Fish · Museum · Stardrops · Polyculture · Rotating Shop Stock[/b][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]功能 · Features[/b][/size]

[b]Community Center 社区中心[/b]
按区域分组查看每个收集包还缺哪些物品，带物品图标和品质星。已完成的区域显示 [已完成]，点击可查看完成清单。
Browse bundles by area and see which items are still missing, with item icons and quality stars. Completed areas display [Completed] and can be clicked to view a completion list.

[b]Joja Community Development Joja社区发展[/b]
加入Joja流程后会将“社区中心”更改为“Joja社区发展”。查看Joja社区发展申请书的项目进度，显示已购买和未购买的项目及其所需花费。
After choosing the Joja route, "Community Center" will be changed to "Joja Community Development". View the progress of Joja Community Development projects, showing purchased and unpurchased upgrades with their required costs.

[b]Grandpa's Evaluation 爷爷的评价[/b]
查看当前得分、已点亮的蜡烛数量，以及距离下一根蜡烛还差多少分。
See your current score, lit candles, and how many points you need for the next candle.

[b]Golden Walnuts 金核桃[/b]
列出所有未收集的金核桃及其线索提示。
Lists all uncollected walnuts with their hint text.

[b]Shipping 出货[/b]
按分类（蔬菜、水果、鱼类等）分组列出所有未寄出的物品。物品[b]一行显示多个[/b]，长列表浏览更快。
All unshipped items grouped by category (vegetables, fruits, fish, etc.). Items are shown [b]multiple per row[/b] for faster browsing.

[b]Cooking 烹饪[/b] / [b]Crafting 制作[/b]
区分 [已学会] 和 [尚未学会]。未学会的会显示获取条件，例如 [乔迪3心事件]、[齐先生的核桃房有售]。
Separates recipes into [Learned] and [Not Learned]. Unlearned recipes show their unlock conditions (e.g. [Jodi 3-heart event], [Sold at Qi's Walnut Room]).

[b]Fishing 钓鱼[/b]
列出尚未钓到的鱼。物品[b]一行显示多个[/b]，整个鱼类图鉴一屏基本看完。
Lists fish you haven't caught yet. Items are shown [b]multiple per row[/b], so the entire fish collection fits on roughly one screen.

[b]Museum 博物馆[/b]
按 [古物] 和 [矿物] 分组列出尚未捐赠的物品，[b]一行显示多个[/b]。
Groups undonated items into [Artifacts] and [Minerals], shown [b]multiple per row[/b].

[b]Stardrops 星之果实[/b]
列出尚未获得的星之果实及其获取方式。
Lists Stardrops you haven't obtained yet, with how to get them.

[b]Polyculture 多样化种植[/b]
列出还需要寄出多少个作物才能完成成就。
Shows how many more of each crop you need to ship for the achievement.

[b]Rotating Shop Stock 商店轮换商品[/b]
查看绿洲、沙漠商人、姜岛商人当天的轮换商品，标注 [今日可购买]、限购信息和获取条件。
View today's rotating stock at the Oasis, Desert Trader, and Island Trader, with [Available Today], purchase limits, and unlock conditions.

[line]

[size=5][b]兼容性 · Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]适用于 Stardew Valley 1.6+ 和 SMAPI 4.0+ / Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]与 SVE 等大型内容 Mod 兼容 / Compatible with SVE and other large content mod[/*]
[*]内置 [b]中文[/b] 与 [b]英文[/b] 翻译，游戏语言为其他语言时回退到英文
Bundled [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]English[/b] translations. Falls back to English for other languages.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]Localization[/b][/size]

[b]English[/b]: This mod ships with Chinese and English translations. If you'd like to translate it into another language, you can create your own i18n file:

[list=1]
[*]Create a folder named
[code]i18n[/code]inside the mod folder (if it doesn't already exist)[/*]
[*]Copy
[code]i18n\default.json[/code]and rename it to your language code (e.g.
[code]ja.json[/code]for Japanese,
[code]ko.json[/code]for Korean,
[code]de.json[/code]for German,
[code]fr.json[/code]for French,
[code]es.json[/code]for Spanish, etc.)[/*]
[*]Open the new file and translate the values (after the colon) into your language. Do not translate the keys (before the colon)[/*]
[*]Save the file. The mod will automatically use your translation based on the game's selected language[/*]
[/list]You're welcome to share your translation in the Posts section or upload it as a separate translation mod. Credit will be given.
